title: The Unquiet: First Rites

texts.details:
You can knit flesh. So can an apothecary with a needle. That is not what a priest is for, even among us.

There is a spirit in the fields north-east of the town. It was a man of Lordaeron, and it does not know it is dead. It walks where it used to walk and rages that no one answers.

We know something the living priests do not, $N. We have been where it is going. We have seen past death, and we know what waits. That is exactly why we do not leave them wandering. Go and give it rest. It will fight you. It thinks you have come to take the last thing it has.
texts.objectives: Lay the Restless Shade to rest, in the fields north-east of Brill, then return to your teacher.
texts.progress: Be gentle, as far as it lets you. You know what it is to wake confused.
texts.completion:
At rest? Good. That is the oldest thing a priest does, whatever he prays to. Older than the Light. Older than the Shadow.

Before one can know the dark, one must also know the light: you were taught that. Here is the other half. One who has been dead owes something to those who are dying badly.

This land has had three wars and a plague, and it is thick with the unquiet. Each is a piece of history no one stayed to bury. I would have you attend them, $N. Take one of these. When you have twenty seasons, go down into the Undercity and find Aelthalyste. She was a banshee before she was a priestess. She knows about not being able to leave.

idea: The Unquiet, level 10 (Horde): lay one restless shade near home, in the voice of the priest's own faith. Invented: the shade.
